scenario: Structure a new medication order into a valid FHIR R4 MedicationRequest.
instruction: Generate a valid FHIR R4 MedicationRequest for the lisinopril 10 mg once-daily order described in the note. Use RxNorm 314076, status active, intent order, authoredOn 2026-05-20, subject Patient/pat-001, and include a dosageInstruction. Respond with only the JSON object {"resource": { ... }}.
